purpose: Side view deployed vs folded: telescoping handle slides down, toe-plate folds up against backbone, tri-star clusters stay fixed; folded 730x380x190mm envelope for van door
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# deployed
ax.plot([0,0],[0,1.1],'k-',lw=3); ax.plot([0,0.24],[0,0],'k-',lw=3); ax.plot([-0.05,0.05],[1.1,1.1],'k-',lw=3)
ax.plot([0.0],[0.15],'o',ms=18); ax.text(-0.15,0.55,'backbone',fontsize=8,rotation=90); ax.text(0.05,0.02,'toe',fontsize=8); ax.text(-0.2,1.15,'handle up',fontsize=8); ax.text(-0.55,0.3,'deployed 1100 high',fontsize=8)
# folded
ax.plot([1.0,1.0],[0.2,0.73],'k-',lw=3); ax.plot([1.0,1.05],[0.2,0.35],'k-',lw=3); ax.plot([0.95,1.05],[0.73,0.73],'k-',lw=2)
ax.plot([1.0],[0.25],'o',ms=18); ax.text(0.85,0.5,'folded',fontsize=8,rotation=90); ax.text(1.1,0.3,'toe up',fontsize=8); ax.text(0.8,0.78,'handle down',fontsize=8); ax.text(0.75,0.05,'730x380x190 env',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-0.7,1.6); ax.set_ylim(-0.1,1.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
